accommodation: Bed and breakfast rooms with a choice of sea views or dog-friendly options; number not stated.
suitableFor: Couples, surfers and dog owners wanting to stay right on the beach.

overview: The Seiners Arms is a pub with bed and breakfast rooms on Beach Road, right on Perranporth seafront, looking out to Chapel Rock and the Atlantic. Rooms have a separate entrance, and the ground floor has a traditional bar and a seafood-led restaurant using local produce.
surfTripFit: Few places in Perranporth sit closer to the surf: the inn is on the beach itself and even runs a surf cam, so checking conditions takes a glance out of the window.
gaps: Room count, parking and board storage not stated.
